note: Adapted from the original English description of Scheffrahn & Křeček 1999, where the species was established as Cryptotermes darlingtonae n. sp.; known from Dominica, Guadeloupe (Grande-Terre), Montserrat, Nevis and Saint Lucia in the Lesser Antilles, an uncommon species of montane forest. Alates: 24 females and 9 males from 4 colonies; soldiers: 22 individuals from 5 colonies. The authors note that the alate is distinguished among the Lesser Antillean species of the genus by the contrasting ochre pronotum and brown wing bases; the soldier is closely related to C. pyrodomus, but in the latter the genal horns are smaller and more deeply sunken, and the frontal horns conceal the genal horns in dorsal view of the frons.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Body pale brown. Sclerotized forewing veins brown; wing membrane nearly transparent, very pale smoky brown. Head, labrum and pronotum pale brown. Pale brown chevron on the forewing scale distinct. Antennae brown. Abdominal tergites yellowish brown, the sternites very pale yellowish brown. Femora nearly white, the ends of the legs (including the tibiae) pale yellowish brown. Head oval, the cranial sutures distinct. Compound eyes medium-sized, slightly straight along the antennal socket. Ocelli medium-sized, oval, almost touching the compound eyes. Antennae 14—17-segmented, usually 15, less often 16; the segment formula variable, usually 2=3=4=5. Pronotum slightly wider than long; anterior and posterior margins slightly concave, the sides moderately convex. Transverse band spot and median line of the pronotum distinct. Radius of the forewing fusing with the wing margin at half the wing length from the suture; radial sector with 6—8 branches. Arolium present.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Measurements (24 females and 9 males, 4 colonies, in mm, the morphotype in parentheses): head length including the labrum 1.06—1.35 (1.16±0.058, 1.14); head length to the postclypeus 0.84—0.90 (0.87±0.016, 0.88); maximum head width across the compound eyes 0.90—0.97 (0.94±0.017, 0.93); compound eye diameter 0.30—0.33 (0.32±0.011, 0.33); shortest distance from the compound eye to the posterior margin of the head 0.12—0.17 (0.14±0.013, 0.17); ocellus diameter 0.11—0.12 (0.12±0.0076, 0.12); maximum pronotal length 0.59—0.69 (0.65±0.025, 0.65); maximum pronotal width 0.84—1.02 (0.91±0.051, 0.96); total body length with wings 8.06—10.14 (9.32±0.514, 9.23); total body length without wings 4.10—5.25 (4.63±0.310, 4.95); forewing length (from the suture) 6.63—7.80 (7.31±0.362, 7.28); maximum forewing width 1.88—2.23 (2.07±0.095, 2.10).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule, in dorsal view, almost black on the anterior third, the middle third grading to dark or very dark chestnut brown, the posterior third rusty or rusty orange; in lateral view almost black on the anterior half, the posterior half rusty or rusty orange. Mandibles very dark chestnut brown. Anterior margin of the pronotum rusty. Head, in dorsal view, nearly rectangular, the posterior corners rounded, the sides slightly constricted behind the frontal margin; each anterolateral corner with a distinct depression. Middle of the vertex concave. Rugae deep and long. Frontal margin distinct, rugose, the anterior edge very shallowly incised or almost straight in dorsal view; median notch deep and continuous with the vertex depression. Frontal horns small, rounded, continuous with the postclypeus and the frontal face, the surface of the horns granular. Genal horns small. Apical third of the mandibles sickle-shaped; teeth short. Eye spots oval, with distinct pigment. Antennae 11—14-segmented, usually 12 or 13; the segment formula usually 2>3=4=5 or 2>3<4=5. Pronotum broadly shield-shaped, the anterior margin with a biconvex incision, the posterolateral corners rounded, the posterior margin with a shallow depression in the middle.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Measurements (22 individuals, 5 colonies, in mm, holotype): head length to the tip of the mandibles 1.58—1.76 (1.67±0.043, 1.66); head length to the frontal horns 1.28—1.49 (1.39±0.052, 1.40); frontal margin width 1.11—1.25 (1.18±0.033, 1.20); outer span of the frontal horns 0.79—0.91 (0.89±0.033, 0.91); maximum head width 1.14—1.26 (1.19±0.029, 1.20); head height without the postmentum 0.91—0.97 (0.94±0.019, 0.94); maximum pronotal width 1.09—1.25 (1.16±0.040, 1.20); maximum pronotal length 0.78—0.92 (0.85±0.040, 0.88); left mandible length (apex to ventral articulation) 0.68—0.75 (0.72±0.023, 0.73); total body length 3.42—4.85 (3.99±0.41, 3.66).
